explanation.en: random provides pseudorandom choices. randint(a, b) includes both endpoints; choice(sequence) selects one element. A seed makes a sequence reproducible, which is useful when testing.
explanation.nl: random biedt pseudowillekeurige keuzes. randint(a, b) omvat beide grenzen; choice(sequence) kiest één element. Met een seed is de reeks reproduceerbaar, wat handig is bij testen.

solution.main.py:
import random
roll = random.randint(1, 6)
selected = random.choice(["north", "south", "west"])
print(roll, selected)

task.en: Import random. Create roll between 1 and 6 and selected from the list north, south, west.
